name: PhDing in the UK
storyline:
A student arrives in the UK to begin a PhD, hoping to build a new life while pursuing a research dream. But between thesis deadlines, demanding supervisors, peer reviews and the final viva, the road to graduation is anything but straightforward.

As the years pass, they must balance research with everyday life, build friendships and find their own way through the challenges of studying far from home.
summary: A pixel-art life sim about surviving a PhD in Sheffield. Manage your time, build a card deck from your own research, and turn academic crises into turn-based battles before the reviewers catch up with you.
